Name: Ferrari 296 GT3 - iRacing v0.1
Author: ScreaM
Description: Replica of the iRacing Ferrari 296 GT3 dashboard

Elements.Name: STINT
Elements.Bind: js:var f=$prop('DataCorePlugin.GameRawData.Telemetry.FuelLevel'); var pit=$prop('DataCorePlugin.GameRawData.Telemetry.OnPitRoad'); var t=$prop('DataCorePlugin.GameRawData.Telemetry.SessionTime'); if(f==null) return null; if(root.startFuel==null || pit || f>root.startFuel || (root.lastTime!=null && t<root.lastTime)) root.startFuel=f; root.lastTime=t; return Math.max(0,root.startFuel-f);

Elements.Name: PRED
Elements.Bind: js:var f=$prop('DataCorePlugin.GameRawData.Telemetry.FuelLevel'); var l=$prop('DataCorePlugin.GameRawData.Telemetry.LapCompleted'); var p=$prop('DataCorePlugin.GameRawData.Telemetry.OnPitRoad'); var t=$prop('DataCorePlugin.GameRawData.Telemetry.SessionTime'); if(f==null || l==null) return null; if(root.lap==null || (root.time!=null && t<root.time) || (root.prevFuel!=null && f>root.prevFuel+0.2)){root.lap=l; root.lapFuel=f; root.canCount=false; root.avg=null;} if(p) root.canCount=false; if(l!=root.lap){var used=root.lapFuel-f; if(root.canCount && used>0) root.avg=root.avg==null?used:root.avg*0.7+used*0.3; root.lap=l; root.lapFuel=f; root.canCount=!p;} root.prevFuel=f; root.time=t; return root.avg;
